title: Basel et al. (2020): CuFeS2 from copper and iron stearates
method: Hot-injection colloidal synthesis from DBU-prepared metal carboxylates

sources.title: DBU-Catalyzed One-Pot Synthesis of Nearly Any Metal Salt of Fatty Acid (M-FA): A Library of Metal Precursors to Semiconductor Nanocrystal Synthesis
sources.authors: Siddhant Basel; Karishma Bhardwaj; Sajan Pradhan; Anand Pariyar; Sudarsan Tamang

materials.name: Iron stearate, source identity conflict
notes: Table 3 prints Fe(stearate)2; Method A product 3f is ferric(III) stearate. Neither identity is silently selected.

stocks.name: Sulfur in oleylamine / 1-octadecene
stocks.scope: Prepared independently from the metal branch; nominal quantities retained without derived concentration.

operations.label: Prepare sulfur stock
operations.description: Combine 0.006 g (0.2 mmol) sulfur with 2.5 mL oleylamine and 1 mL 1-octadecene.

operations.label: Hold sulfur stock at 160 °C
operations.description: Under nitrogen raise the stock to 160 °C and hold; hold duration unreported.

operations.label: Prepare metal precursor mixture
operations.description: Combine iron stearate, copper stearate and 3 mL 1-octadecene.

environment.note: Degassing is explicitly reported; the evacuation method and absolute pressure are not specified for this step.

operations.label: Add dodecanethiol
operations.description: Fill with nitrogen and add 1.5 mL dodecanethiol.

operations.label: Inject sulfur stock dropwise
operations.description: Add the independently heated sulfur stock dropwise to the metal branch at 180 °C. Injection rate and total addition time unreported.

operations.label: Grow after addition
operations.description: Continue at 180 °C for another 10 min after sulfur addition.

operations.label: Quench in cold water
operations.description: Quench with cold water; exact bath temperature unreported.

operations.label: Isolate CuFeS2
operations.description: Mix 4 mL crude with 4 mL anhydrous toluene and 16 mL anhydrous ethanol. Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 10 min and discard supernatant.

operations.label: First mixed-solvent wash
operations.description: Wash with hexane/ethanol 1:4 at 5000 rpm for 5 min; absolute volumes unreported.

operations.label: Second mixed-solvent wash
operations.description: Centrifuge with the same solvent mixture at 5000 rpm for 3 min.
